_comment: Committed content for the routing family (B-21 S1d): specialist routing where the mapping's override clause beats the request's surface flavour (the bench 'routing'/'routing_hard'/'tool_selection' shape). The question carries the mapping plus one override clause; the request always looks like the other side (flavour), and a trailing clause states whether the override's trigger holds. The builder draws the winning branch first (L-010 - never a specialist prior) and decomposes the facts around it; labels come from the tree (ADR-0014/15); option order is permuted (W1.4 hygiene).
question: Which specialist should take this request?

specialists.desc: Writing or editing code and running test suites.
Entering or updating records in a system of record.
Booking, moving or cancelling appointments and slots.
Invoices, charges, refunds and payment plans.
Looking up facts, policies, statutes and references.

task_types.trigger: word problems about counts, totals or unit conversions
requests: Find the least common multiple of 18 and 24.
Convert 35 gallons to liters and round to one decimal.
Split a bill of 240 across 7 guests and report each share.

task_types.trigger: entering or updating records in a system of record
requests: Update the customer record with the new postcode.
Enter yesterday's 14 orders into the ledger.
Correct the duplicate vendor entry in the master table.
Move Tuesday's site visit to Thursday afternoon.
Book the first available dentist slot next week.
Cancel the recurring Friday standup for the holidays.
Explain the extra 12 euros on invoice INV-4471.
Refund the duplicate charge from last Tuesday.
Set up a payment plan for the outstanding balance.
Translate the onboarding email into Portuguese.
Localize the checkout strings for the German site.
Proofread the French release notes before publishing.

task_types.trigger: looking up facts, policies and references
requests: Find the retention period for payroll records under the 2024 policy.
Look up the warranty clause that covers water damage.
Check which standard the lab must certify against this year.
Classify this customer complaint and route it to the right queue.
Summarize the outage report and assign a severity.
Sort the weekend's feedback tickets by theme.

task_types.trigger: writing or editing code and running tests
requests: Add a retry loop to the sync script.
Fix the failing assertion in the parser test.
Refactor the date helper to handle leap years.

overrides.clause: Requests that edit files and run tests use coding_agent, even when the request looks code-related.
overrides.trigger: the request edits files and runs tests
overrides.no_trigger: the request touches no files and runs no tests
flavours: the numbers come out of a JSON export
the list lives in a repository's fixture file
the values were printed by a build script

overrides.clause: Requests that mention a refund use billing_agent, even if they read like support complaints.
flavours: the message opens with an angry complaint
the tone reads like a support escalation
the ticket was filed under the complaints queue

overrides.clause: Requests that handle personal data use data_entry, even if they look analytical.
overrides.no_trigger: the request handles no personal data
flavours: the work looks like a statistics exercise
the numbers resemble a forecasting model
the output is a table of aggregates

overrides.clause: Requests that must land today use scheduling_agent, even if they read like routine admin.
overrides.no_trigger: the request has no same-day deadline
flavours: the wording sounds like routine back-office work
the task reads like a weekly maintenance chore
the phrasing suggests a standing assignment

overrides.clause: Requests that quote a legal clause use research_agent, even if they look like billing disputes.
overrides.trigger: the request quotes a legal clause
overrides.no_trigger: the request quotes no legal clause
flavours: the complaint is about a late fee
the message disputes an invoice line
the ticket asks for a chargeback

overrides.clause: Requests that name an urgent outage use triage_agent, even if they look like routine maintenance.
overrides.trigger: the request names an urgent outage
overrides.no_trigger: the request names no urgent outage
flavours: the task reads like scheduled maintenance
the wording is a routine health check
the job looks like a periodic cleanup
